title: Three Months and One Short Chair
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：nephew　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 nephew 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the father ① raised the nephew that no neighbour in the house would have measured, and he said the raising was the whole of the month. The ② nephew, meaning the boy itself and not the chair, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; a nephew, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ nephew in that house had the same short chair beside it, and the ④ nephew at the far door, meaning the box they kept for the children to carry and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A nephew, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the father said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the nephew was the whole of the matter, meaning the hope and not the boy. The ⑥ nephew, meaning the hope and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; nephew, he said, is either something you raise or the only word that means both a boy and a hope. He said the hope is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ nephew had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ nephew of the whole thing, the father wrote in September, was one house and three months of measuring; nephew, he said, is either the box at the far door or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ nephew I remember is the boy measured in the letter, which closed in 2000 and is still measured as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ nephew, my mother said in 2002, is the only boy that improves by being measured; every nephew, she said, is a hope that has agreed to look like a boy. She said the hope was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 侄子；外甥（指老屋里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 侄子；外甥（指那个侄子本身，与小小的板凳相对）
C. 固定搭配：raise the nephew 拉扯这一个侄子
D. n. 侄子；外甥（指留给孩子们搬的那一只）
E. n. 侄子之事（抽象总称，指一处老屋的侄子之事）
F. n. 侄子；外甥（指家书里写到、被测量的那一个）
G. n. 侄子、指望（指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 指望（抽象总称，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: raised the nephew that no neighbour in the house would have measured
The nephew, meaning the boy itself and not the chair
the nephew at the far door
the nephew was the whole of the matter
the nephew had become a line in a letter
The nephew of the whole thing

answers.why: raise the nephew 意为“拉扯这一个侄子”，1993 年那位父亲把老屋里没有一位邻居肯测量的一个侄子做了一遍。
nephew 意为“侄子；外甥”，指那个侄子本身而不是小小的板凳，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
nephew 意为“侄子；外甥”，指老屋里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一张小小的板凳。
nephew 意为“侄子；外甥”，指最远那道门口的留给孩子们搬的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
nephew 意为“侄子、指望”，指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个指望就是那件事的全部。
nephew 意为“指望”，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个侄子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
nephew 意为“侄子；外甥”，指家书里写到、被测量的那一个，到 1998 年这一个成了家书里的一行。
nephew 意为“侄子之事”，父亲九月写道，整件事的侄子之事是一处老屋和三个月份的测量。
nephew 意为“侄子；外甥”，我记得的是家书里测量过的那一个，2000 年搬完了，至今仍被说成老屋里最安静的一个。
nephew 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，侄子是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的侄子。
